doc: The 'utilities' group of host calls (cleat#3827). Each call is listed here as unbound ('pending: ...') until its binding lands; the PR that binds a call moves its entry from 'unbound' to 'bound' in THIS file and touches no other inventory file. See packages/cleat-ts/groups/README.md.

unbound.cleat_fetch: pending: an outbound HTTP request through the host, so it is recorded and replayable.
unbound.cleat_json_parse: pending: the host's canonical JSON parse; cleat_json_stringify is bound, so this is its sibling.
